thread:
ana: Short RFC follow-up: propose a simple, robust auto-fallback pattern for canaries that avoids flapping. Key ideas: signal conjunction, region quorum, mirror warmup, circuit backoff.

ben: +1. Suggest require 2+ signal types (errors, latency, anchor regressions) for a trigger. Single-signal = advisory only.

charlie: Region quorums matter. Only trigger if >1 region or 50% of active regions show degradation. Prevents single-POP blips.

deploy-bot: [notice] canary v12 deployed to eu, us-west, ap-southeast. Monitoring started. :robot_face:

dan: Warmup: before routing flip, run mirror-warmup 0.5% -> 2% over 3m with prefix affinity to prefill KV. If warmup metrics OK, commit flip.

ellen: Circuit rules: maintain a fail_counter with decay. On auto-fallback, set cool_down base=10m and double on repeated auto events up to cap. Manual override resets counter.

ana: (typo) ana: also require eval-anchor confidence > 0.6 to weight synthetic signals higher. Record sample sizes in trigger payload.

ben: Router API sketch: POST /runtime/fallbacks {from, to, reason, token} -> returns id. GET /runtime/fallbacks/{id} -> status + mirror plan. Must be idempotent.

charlie: Observability: store trigger blob: metrics, regions, sample sizes, anchor hash, decision trace. Keep 90d.

ana: action items: ben+dan draft API + mirror plan, charlie+ellen draft scorer params & decay math, ana assemble RFC. Aim: draft in one week.
